description: Library code for git p4 tests, including setup and utility functions for testing Perforce (p4) integration with git, such as starting/stopping p4d server, creating users and jobs, handling paths on Cygwin, and managing test environment.

methods.name: native_path
methods.description: Converts a given path to Windows format on Cygwin or resolves real path otherwise.

methods.name: start_p4d
methods.description: Starts a Perforce p4d server instance with environment setup and waits until it is ready.

methods.name: stop_p4d_and_watchdog
methods.description: Kills the p4d server and associated watchdog process.

methods.name: p4_add_user
methods.description: Creates a new Perforce user with specified name and optional full name.

methods.name: p4_add_job
methods.description: Creates a new Perforce job with specified ID and open status.

methods.name: retry_until_success
methods.description: Retries a command until success or timeout.

methods.name: stop_and_cleanup_p4d
methods.description: Stops the p4d server and cleans up related files.

methods.name: cleanup_git
methods.description: Removes and recreates the git directory used for testing.

methods.name: marshal_dump
methods.description: Dumps a specific key from a marshaled Python object via a temporary script.

methods.name: client_view
methods.description: Constructs a Perforce client with specified view lines.

methods.name: is_cli_file_writeable
methods.description: Checks if a file is writable, with special handling for Cygwin.
